newsitem.title: USA: Fisher-Price recalls 17,000 toy police cars.
newsitem.headline: Fisher-Price recalls 17,000 toy police cars.

text.p: Fisher-Price Inc. is recalling about 17,000 toy police cars sold since February after finding that they present a potential choking hazard to children, the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission said Monday.
The commission said it and the toymaker, a Mattel Inc. unit based in East Aurora, N.Y., were not aware of any injuries involving the toys.
The recall is being made to prevent the possibility of injury, which may happen because the back of some of the cars could crack and break apart, the commission said.
The $8 plastic police car is part of the Little People Roadside Rescue vehicle set. The other toys in the set are not involved in the recall.
Mattel's stock fell 25 cents to $28.75 on the New York Stock Exchange in afternoon trading.
